name: Algebraic Threshold Obfuscation
description: Transforms the boolean logic of a 2-SAT clause (at least one literal must be true) into a single linear inequality over binary variables. By defining an "interference" value $E$ and a threshold $C$, the condition $E > C$ algebraically evaluates to false if and only if both literals are false. This forces models to algebraically deduce the truth table before they can recognize the 2-SAT structure, breaking direct pattern-matching from the signed integer inputs to boolean literals.
